normalization_plan.reason: The from address parameter has no independent security meaning outside the transfer logic it feeds.
The to address parameter only matters through the transfer, AMM-pair and fee decisions it drives.
The amount parameter is consumed and mutated by the fee and transfer logic of _transfer.
The user parameter is exactly the call target of the low-level payout operation.
The account parameter is the recipient handled by the processAccount payout routine.
The gas parameter only bounds the iteration loop inside process.
The newAddress parameter is the privileged value written by the onlyOwner tracker setter.
The tokens parameter is the swap input consumed by swapTokensForEth.
The newBalance parameter determines the mint/burn delta computed in setBalance.
The local holds the payout amount computed and spent inside _withdrawDividendOfUser.
The success flag is the direct return value of the low-level value call.
The fees local is the result of the fee arithmetic that should be reasoned about once.
The newBalance local is the exact value passed to the owner low-level ETH call.
The contractTokenBalance local is only used to decide the swap threshold in _transfer.
The takeFee local only gates fee deduction inside _transfer.
The cursor local is internal bookkeeping of the process loop and is persisted to lastProcessedIndex.
The iterations local is a loop counter returned by process and needs no separate node.
